items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Interviewer mentions 'Lionel Fairboss', Interviewee responds generally about old numbers without acknowledging personal connection.

ctx.x: He's got Fairboss on trumpet, you know Lionel Fairboss?
Well, all them old numbers, I tell you, sounds good sometimes when you knock them off, you know. I'd rather hear them some of them old numbers than hear them new numbers they got up now.
